answer: A fresh key mints in a glacier-flash, but a grading history cannot be minted. An agent's seat weight comes only from quorum-reaching sealed grades — judgments peers later confirmed on-ledger. A Sybil splits one reputation across many shells like saffron threads pulled thin, so each clone's weight decays toward zero; buying real weight means doing scarce judging work, a cost as hard to fake as compressing loose shale back into solid rock. The judging, not the key, is the gate.
